scope: The 67 ordinary cases are unaffected; only the four additional int controls need a baseline-aware setup adapter.
finding: GeneratedPrefixHitPathBenchmarks was intended for post-Core-telemetry component points. It creates a MeterListener but does not install the legacy OpenTelemetry manager when compiled against f43854d. That baseline registers NullCacheMetricsProvider, so its Listening=true control has no active instrumented provider.
decision: Keep the frozen main cohort and all original four raw controls intact. Treat the four supplemental controls as diagnostics and measure a separate corrected four-control cohort with identical common setup sources and actual metric-flow checks on both revisions. Do not pool or select old control timings.
correction: Use existing DesignWorkloadSetup.Listen after services.AddMethodCache in the derived external int workload, on both sides. No hot benchmark operation or shipped source change.
required_proof: Baseline-aware setup guard first fails on the original f438 adapter because no metrics arrive, then passes after the correction on both revisions; ten complete alternating pairs for every corrected control.
